best_for: Windows developers who want a free Git GUI with a branch graph, Explorer right-click menus and a Visual Studio extension.

points.title: Windows only
points.text: The current releases are a Windows tool and need Windows 10 or later. Mac and Linux users need another client.

points.title: Sits inside Explorer and Visual Studio
points.text: It adds Git commands to Explorer's right-click menu, and an extension for Visual Studio 2022 and later is on the Marketplace. A separate Visual Studio Code extension also exists.

points.title: History that follows renames
points.text: The commit log shows a branch graph, file history follows files that were moved or renamed, and blame shows who last changed each line.

points.title: Free under the GPL
points.text: Git Extensions is GPL-3.0 open source with no paid edition and no account.

points.title: Portable build for locked-down PCs
points.text: The installers here are machine-wide and need administrator rights. A portable version is also offered; to update it, keep your settings files and replace the rest.

points.title: Arm64 included
points.text: Installers come for x64 and Arm64. The Windows listing keeps 23 versions, so you can step back if a release breaks your setup.
